summary: Iteration 8 — Aluminum Inventory (2-finish + thresholds + Purchase-Order PDF) end-to-end PASS. BACKEND: 13/13 pytest cases green (test_alu_inventory.py) covering list normalization (legacy rows defaulted to finish='clair', restock_min/max present), 401 unauth guard, create clair, create noir-with-same-key (separate row), same-finish-create merges qty (3+5→8 on same id), patch delta increments + clamps at 0, patch thresholds set + unset (None clears), purchase-order.pdf via ?token= query param returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF- magic, ?finish=clair|noir filtered PDF, and 401 without token. FRONTEND: Playwright PortechAdmin/Portech2026! login → /admin/gestion/inventaire-alu → InventoryPanel renders. Verified: Ajouter modal opens; preset dropdown auto-fills profile_key='AT Fabrication #ATT1005' + label + length=6800; clair/noir segmented control toggles with clear visual selected state (bg-[#0c182b] text-white on selected); submit adds row; adding NOIR + then CLAIR same key/length creates 2 distinct rows; adding CLAIR again (qty=4) MERGES into existing clair row (still 2 rows total, qty=5); filter chips show counts 'TOUT (2) / CLAIR (1) / NOIR (1)' and correctly filter the table to 1 row each; pencil thresholds modal saves min=2/max=10 and 2/5; status badges render correctly: 'OK' (clair qty=5>min=2), 'BAS' (noir qty=1<=min=2); '1 réf. à recommander' summary banner appears; mini progress bar shows red below-min and green above-min; cleanup via trash icon successfully removed all 2 test rows; inventory back to 0/0/0 prior state. PO PDF button uses window.open with ?token= as designed (popup verification flaky in headless but backend PDF generation fully verified via direct GET).

issues: React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning). Likely from a nearby component rendering a span inside an option. Not blocking, but should be hunted down to clean console output.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered on the inventaire-alu page — affects no functionality but pollutes the console.

Consider exposing the PO PDF download URL via an <a target='_blank' rel='noopener'> instead of window.open() for slightly better testability and accessibility (also avoids popup-blocker edge cases on some browsers).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (atelier_routes.py) is clean: proper Pydantic validation, finish whitelist enforced server-side, ObjectId excluded via projection {_id:0}, async + motor, status codes 201/204/404/401 correct, legacy migration handled via _normalize_row (restock_threshold → restock_min).
Token-via-query-param for PDF download (server.py get_current_admin) is intentional and documented; same JWT as Bearer and short-lived — acceptable trade-off for native browser downloads.

Frontend InventoryPanel.jsx is well-structured (small primitives FilterChip / FinishDot / StatusBadge / QtyProgressBar), all interactive elements carry data-testid (inv-add, inv-add-modal, inv-preset-select, inv-finish-clair/noir, inv-add-submit, inv-filter-all/clair/noir, inv-thresholds-<id>, inv-thresholds-modal, inv-thresholds-save, inv-po-pdf, inv-del-<id>, inv-row-<id>).
Minor: PO download uses window.open which can be blocked by popup blockers on some browsers; consider an anchor with download attribute as a progressive enhancement.

Backend pytest also creates rows under 'TEST_AT_Fab #ZZTEST001' and cleans them via TestCleanup.test_zzz_cleanup_created_rows. Verified final state: 0 bars / 0 chutes (prior state preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory feature is fully verified. New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_alu_inventory.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_alu_inventory.py -v. UI flows tested through real REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with PortechAdmin. The PO PDF popup verification via expect_popup was flaky in headless mode (timeout fetching the PDF binary), but the button is wired correctly and the backend endpoint is fully covered by direct GET tests with ?token= — no functional gap.
